name: io.github.chemodun/x4-script-mcp
title: X4CodeSense
description: X4: Foundations scripts: checks, schema elements, expression types, scripts, cues and texts.

packageArguments.name: --extensions
packageArguments.description: An extension, or a folder of extensions, whose scripts and texts are read: those you write and those they refer to. Default: the current folder.

environmentVariables.name: X4_GAME
environmentVariables.description: The installed game, the folder of X4.exe; its files are read from the catalogs.

environmentVariables.name: X4_UNPACKED
environmentVariables.description: The extracted game files, the folder holding libraries, md and aiscripts; used instead of X4_GAME.
